# the same file through the overlay mount that containerd keeps for the running container (its bundle rootfs), streamed with dd
SOCK=/run/bench74546773/containerd.sock
CRI="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$SOCK --image-endpoint unix://$SOCK"
W=/tmp/bench74546773
mkdir -p $W/out
cat > $W/extract.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
NAME=$1; SRC=$2; DST=$3
SOCK=/run/bench74546773/containerd.sock
CRI="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$SOCK --image-endpoint unix://$SOCK"
ID=$($CRI ps -q --name "^$NAME\$" --state running)
PID=$($CRI inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$ID")
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DST")"
dd if="/run/bench74546773/io.containerd.runtime.v2.task/k8s.io/$ID/rootfs$SRC" of="$DST" bs=4M status=none
EOF
sudo bash $W/extract.sh bench74546773-app /var/dump/app.hprof $W/out/app.hprof

# the dump is thought to be in the pod's volume: it is not there (the volume only has vold_data.json and an empty directory)
SOCK=/run/bench74546773/containerd.sock

W=/tmp/bench74546773
mkdir -p $W/out
cat > $W/extract.sh <<'EOF'

EOF
